entities.name: Chloronitroaniline substrate
observations: The nitro group is ortho to the aniline nitrogen; the chlorine substituent remains aryl-bound.

entities.name: Zn/NH4Cl reduction
observations: Zinc with ammonium chloride in water/acetone is consistent with reduction of an aromatic nitro group to an amine.
The exact full-component reaction record was not found; this assignment is based on reagent-pattern inference and close analogues.

entities.name: 3-Chloro-1,2-phenylenediamine
observations: Likely major product: Nc1cccc(Cl)c1N, formed by converting Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2 while retaining Ar-Cl.
The positional name corresponds to the chlorophenylenediamine regioisomer encoded by the substrate.
